name: bookette
description: Tax-year bookkeeping for 1099 workers, landlords and short-term rental hosts, kept in a folder on your machine.

plugins.name: bookette
plugins.description: For 1099 workers, landlords and short-term rental hosts: turn receipts, statements and 1099s into Schedule C and E books for your accountant. Tax-year bookkeeping in your own Claude Code session, K-1s included. Every figure comes from calculation code, never from a model. Your files stay in a folder on your machine; nothing is uploaded to Bookette. Bookette does not prepare or file a return or give tax advice.
